subject: planner: UPDATE's select plan's output col IDs should be stable (#53268)
summary: Changes UPDATE planning to track all column UniqueIDs referenced inside assignment RHS expressions (via `expression.ExtractColumnSet`) into `StmtCtx.ColRefFromUpdatePlan` (now an `intset.FastIntSet`), and refines post-physical `PhysicalProjection` elimination to keep a projection only when eliminating it would change the output column UniqueIDs for those tracked refs. This prevents UPDATE ordered assignments from failing to resolve columns after postOptimize projection elimination (notably in UPDATE-with-subquery cases like #53236), while allowing safe elimination when child/projection schema UniqueIDs already match.
